title: AE morning scratchpad - outreach sprints & follow-ups
content:
Quick morning dump — Alex

Goals for today (quick):
- 9:00–11:30: cold outbound sprint (60 dials + 30 personalized emails)
- 11:45: review cal syncs, prep for demo w/ CloudRetail (2pm)
- 14:00–15:00: demo + discovery for CloudRetail -> confirm ingest pipeline
- 15:30–17:00: follow-ups / touch-base with MQLs (prioritize demo requests)
- End of day: update SFDC, move any stuck opps to 'needs champion'

Priority call list (order = how I’ll tackle):
1) VeloHealth - Pri: High - Contact: Priya Rao (CTO) - Last touched: 2026-04-09 - Notes: interested in Dedicated for PII workload; send private deployment checklist + benchmark doc. Next action: email w/ 2 bullets + link to dedicated pricing (ASAP).
2) CloudRetail - Pri: Med-High - Contact: Miguel Torres (Head of ML) - Last touched: 2026-04-11 - Notes: scheduled demo 2pm today, wants latency examples at 1k qps and cost per 1M tokens. Prep items: bring up batching/caching examples, mention Optimize suggestions.
3) ArkData - Pri: Med - Contact: Elena Park (Eng Mgr) - Last touched: 2026-03-30 - Notes: POC stalled; ask about infra blockers (VPC vs on-prem). Next action: push for 15-min sync this week.
4) FinchBank - Pri: Low - Contact: Tom Li (Sec Ops) - Last touched: 2026-04-01 - Notes: compliance questions; send KMS/HSM doc + SOC2 excerpt.
5) NovaGames - Pri: Low - Contact: Chris O. (CTO) - Last touched: 2026-04-02 - Notes: small pilot interest for chat moderation; recommend hosted API to start.

Follow-up queue (actionable, <48h):
- RED-4821: internal ask — get updated dedicated pricing sheet from finance (Sam).
- Send case study to VeloHealth that shows latency SLOs with Dedicated GPUs (short).
- Email CloudRetail after demo: include replay + step to pilot (50k tokens/week).

Short email snippets (copy/paste, keep concise):
- For Dedicated intro: "Priya — quick note: attached a short checklist for private Dedicated deployments (networking & compliance) and a one-page cost example for 500k tokens/mo. Happy to hop on 15m if useful. — Alex"
- For demo follow-up: "Miguel — great demo earlier. Link to recording + recommended pilot: 50k tokens/week, Dedicated preview with autoscale off, estimated monthly commit < $X. Next step: contract 1-page SOW?"

Objections cheat (two-liners):
- "We can’t manage the infra": "We offer Private with a customer-managed control plane and Redwood handles the inference runtime — minimal infra ops required. We provide an on-prem package if air-gapped is needed."
- "Cost is too high": "We surface cost levers (batching, quantization, caching) and provide Optimize recommendations so unit economics improve as you scale. Can run a short POC to prove it."

Notes to self (todo / check):
- Ask Solutions Eng for a fresh perf matrix for 2xA100 vs 4xH100 for CloudRetail demo (ticketed).
- Update my SFDC list: mark CloudRetail as demo scheduled, VeloHealth as engaged.
- Re-check calendar for Friday: reserved slot for doing LinkedIn sequence touch (blocks: 10:30–11:00).

Random thoughts / quick experiments to try this week:
- Short ROI deck for platform teams: show how Dedicated reduces tail latency with smart routing — 3 slides.
- Try 2-step email: 1) problem statement + 1 metric (latency/cost), 2) short ask (15m). A/B subject lines.

Stuck opps (why stalled):
- ArkData: unclear owner; need an exec sponsor. Action: ask internal champion to intro.
- FinchBank: legal loop slow. Add a calendar invite for QBR with legal.

Metrics snapshot (quick, not exact):
- This week: 32 calls, 18 emails, 3 demos scheduled, 1 closed-won (sandbox pilot)
- Target: 50 calls, 30 emails, 5 demos

Misc quick links (copy for messages):
- Dedicated overview: https://app.redwood.ai/docs/dedicated
- Private deployment brief: https://app.redwood.ai/docs/private-deployments

End-of-day checklist:
- SFDC updates + move notes to opportunities
- Slack recap in #sales-daily (1–2 bullets)
- Prep tomorrow’s top 5 list

Notes to self (last):
- Keep outreach conversational — mention one data point specific to their business (latency, cost, compliance).
- Follow up on RED-4821 with Sam before EOD (finance may need details).

-- Alex
